source: Fyers support, 'What are the FYERS API rate limits for Standard and Prime plans?' — Data APIs (history, quotes, depth, …) on the Standard plan: 5/s, 50/min, 5,000/day. Breaching the per-minute cap more than 3 times in a day blocks the user for the rest of the day (Fyers rate-limits reference). Reset time is not documented; the ledger uses IST calendar days.
